description: Land Acquisition - Polonnaruwa & Kaduruwela, Thamankaduwa D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes (road development). It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and current claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
